description: Source code for audio transformation utilities specific to Windows platform, including media format conversion and media transform creation for audio codecs like AAC and AC3.

classes.name: WinAudioFormat
classes.description: Helper class to create and manage Windows media format structures for AAC and AC3 audio streams.

methods.name: ConvertToWin32AudioCodec
methods.description: Converts internal media audio codec enum to Windows GUID format.

methods.name: ConvertToWin32TransformType
methods.description: Returns the GUID for the Windows Media Foundation transform corresponding to the codec.

methods.name: ConvertToWin32OutputFormat
methods.description: Returns the output format GUID for the specified codec.

methods.name: WinAudioFormat::CreateAacAudioFormat
methods.description: Creates WAVEFORMATEX structure for AAC audio stream.

methods.name: WinAudioFormat::CreateAc3AudioFormat
methods.description: Creates WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE structure for AC3 audio stream.

methods.name: CreateAudioTransform
methods.description: Creates and configures a media transform for the specified audio stream info.
